chapter_mission: Jacen murders Nelani Dinn. Brooks Climax — thematic, not kinetic.
chapter_turn: The corruption arc crosses from inclination to enactment; Jacen takes the step from which no re-tread is possible.

scene_plan.purpose: The fight itself — brief, precise; Nelani killed.
Ben in the doorway; Jacen standing over the body; the interior reckoning begins.

exit_vector: Nelani's body on the chamber floor; Ben in the doorway; Jacen's face registering a calculation he will not describe even to himself.
notes: The book's thematic climax. Allston does not dwell — the fight is short, the moment after it is the chapter.
